Actor Hospitalized, Family Seeks Financial Aid

An actor, known for the show 'Bhabiji Ghar Par Hain!', has been hospitalized for the ninth time due to a serious illness, with his condition described as critical. His family has reportedly sold their house to cover medical expenses and has appealed for financial assistance. His sister has also made a plea for help.
